answer: Auctioned seasonal operating licenses stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each quarter only 500 licenses are auctioned, starting at $50, so a fleet cannot flood in. Second, each winner locks a $100 bond for ninety days, lost on fraud. Third, licenses cannot transfer and expire each season, forcing fresh bids. Fourth, fraud burns the bond and bans bidding for a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 licenses at $80 each plus $100,000 in bonds, $180,000 lost if caught. Trust rides a ridge above an ocean of copies, sharp as a falcon watching a harbour where only licensed boats dock.
